memory_rule: the s32 cell runs only when the s8 rehearsal exits 0 with a maximum resident set size of at most 34359738368 bytes (32 GiB) on this 48 GB host; otherwise the arm is BLOCKED (failure_class implementation)
stop_rule: a watchdog terminates the pinned apr processes when their summed resident size passes 38654705664 bytes (36 GiB); a watchdog stop is a non-zero rehearsal and blocks the arm
rehearsal_quality_excluded: the s8 rehearsal measures memory only: its accuracy and dump are excluded from every recipe decision and from the bake-off

rss_control.method: /usr/bin/time -l just --justfile /tmp/p12-10-ctl.just alloc (python3 -I allocates and touches 4 GiB); same time -> just -> shell -> process nesting as the cell

rehearsal.watchdog_note: 5 s sampling of the summed RSS of the pinned apr processes; its peak is a lower bound of the time -l maximum
rehearsal.ok_line: SETFIT CELL OK cell=s8e1b16 seed=13 artifact_sha256=0532fe5dda9c6b13253f16cb23f5d4223526df0a6918dfa7b1795e849bdc3602 metric_tag=accuracy value=<excluded> n_rows=100 train_seconds=49
rehearsal.ok_line_note: the accuracy value is redacted here on purpose: the rehearsal's quality is excluded from every decision

deviation: D-25: s64 is infeasible (pools after the 0.1 validation carve: conspiratorial 36, social_affiliative 59, below 64); s32 is the largest legal cell; subsampled train (96 of 295 rows)

dump.row_identity: row_ids test:0..test:99 and text_sha256 equal to data.exact_sha256 of the eval texts in order (checked)

provenance_control: dump dataset_fingerprint and artifact_sha256 equal eval-test.json's; row ids and per-row text sha256 match data/decide/motivation-v1/eval.jsonl row by row; predicted is the argmax of every probability row
device: cpu (the SetFit trainer is CPU-only by design)
scope_note: SetFit is a reference arm only (D-06). macro-F1, false-assignment and length bands are computed by bakeoff.py (plan 12-16), not here.
